> Thanks for working with us on the SIG follow-up. Our security team is asking for concrete artifacts related to Redwood's key management practices for the ClearWave pilot. Specifically we need: ...

Technical clarifications (summary):
- Envelope encryption model: customer data is encrypted with per-tenant data keys which are wrapped by a tenant CMK. The CMK is either customer-supplied (BYOK) in Private deployments or Redwood-managed in Hosted.
- BYOK import flow (Private): ClearWave generates a master key in your HSM or KMS, provides proof-of-possession and a signed import token. The import process is performed over a mutually authenticated TLS channel; we never persist raw key material outside the import operation.
- HSM/Provider: For on-prem/Private we support industry-standard HSMs (vendor-specific attestations are included in the attached PDF). For Hosted we currently use cloud KMS backed by a validated HSM (cloud provider attestation included).
- Rotation: We support automatic rewrapping of data keys when CMKs rotate. Recommended cryptoperiods: 90 days for ephemeral data keys (automatic), 365 days for tenant CMKs by default; configurable per-customer. Key destruction is irreversible and logged; we keep key metadata and operation logs for 1 year by default (configurable per contract).
- Audit evidence: sample log excerpt attached; full audit export requires a signed transfer request and will be delivered via secure transfer.

Attachments: rotation-schedule.csv (shows default cadences and recommended settings) and an explanatory note. Please confirm if you need a longer retention window for logs or full raw audit exports.
